cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import ctypes, json, random, sys, time
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.finite import compile_job

def jobA():
    # 16 cells of domain [0,1] -> U = 65536; 32 never-true predicates -> max DFS nodes
    fields=[{'name':f'f{i}','type':['time','size','count','id','flag'][i%5],'domain':[0,1]} for i in range(16)]
    preds=[{'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,f'f{i%16}']},'op':'eq','right':{'const':7,'type':fields[i%16]['type']}} for i in range(32)]
    rng=random.Random(3)
    train=[[[rng.choice([0,1]) for _ in range(16)]] for _ in range(10000)]
    queries=[{'target':[0,'f0'],'prefix':'','fixed':[]} for _ in range(64)]
    return {'fields':fields,'slots':1,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,'approved':[],'queries':queries}

t=time.time(); res=compile_job(jobA()); dt=time.time()-t
print('jobA (never-true preds, N=10000): %.3fs rules=%d answers=%d' % (dt, len(res['rules']), len(res['answers'])))
print(' answer0:', res['answers'][0])

def jobB(ntrain=4, P=32):
    fields=[{'name':f'f{i}','type':['time','size','count','id','flag'][i%5],'domain':[0,1]} for i in range(16)]
    preds=[]
    for i in range(P):
        cell=i%16
        val=(i//16)%2
        preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,fields[cell]['name']]},'op':'eq','right':{'const':val,'type':fields[cell]['type']}})
    train=[[[ (1 if (w==1 or w==3) and j==0 else (1 if (w==2 or w==3) and j==1 else 0)) for j in range(16)]] for w in range(ntrain)]
    queries=[{'target':[0,'f0'],'prefix':'','fixed':[]} for _ in range(64)]
    return {'fields':fields,'slots':1,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,'approved':[],'queries':queries}

for n in (4,6,8):
    t=time.time(); res=compile_job(jobB(n)); dt=time.time()-t
    print('jobB N=%d: %.3fs rules=%d out=%dKiB' % (n, dt, len(res['rules']), len(json.dumps(res))//1024))
PYEOF
